Name: Help My Rabbit Sounds Wrong
Author: Campaigner
Description:
==================
WHAT IS THIS?
==================
Have you ever wanted your coop to be a bit more lively? Maybe... noisier? Well this mod does just that! Your rabbit will make new sounds, and you can choose what sounds they are! Your rabbit can sound like;

- A cackling witch
- A camel grunting
- The 10 second Gorilla cutscene
- A ringing phone
- A UFO
- A sparkly effect

You can select one of the above sound effects by editing the config file, or by using Generic Mod Config Menu.


==================
REQUIRED MODS
==================
"Content Patcher" by Pathoschild
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915 [/url]
- Required.


==================
SUGGESTED MODS
==================
"Generic Mod Config Menu" by spacechase0
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098[/url]
- Lets you change the config while playing.
- Demonstrated in the image on the Nexus page.


==================
KNOWN ISSUES:
==================
None so far! Let me know in the comments section if you run into any issues! Be sure to run your error log through SMAPI's log parser tool as well, otherwise I might not know how to fix the issue. The log parser can be found at SMAPI's official site: https://smapi.io/log

Downloads.Description: Initial Release. May add more sounds later down the line, as this was done as a joke and entirely on a whim.
